method.name: findIssuesByTitleToken
method.purpose: exact-token title lookup (title equals the artifact id, or starts with it followed by an em dash and a space); added to TrackerPort by Story s1, which implements it with the GitHub adapter and the fake; s6 builds on it and adds no second title lookup

rationale: Story s1 needs one title lookup on TrackerPort to avoid duplicating older issues; sc6 (owned by s6) owns the port additions, so the method is recorded on sc6 as an s1/s6 ownership exception.
